source: Outlines (s) and medians (m) use the Make Me a Hanzi graphics coordinate system (1024 canvas, y axis flipped by scale(1,-1) translate(0,-900), matching hzT in src/quiz/pinyin-stroke.js). The same paths are published per character by hanzi-writer-data, which is derived from Make Me a Hanzi graphics.txt (Arphic PL KaitiM GB / Arphic PL UKai). Character 火 stroke 0 and its first median were compared with hanzi-writer-data@2.0.1 and matched.
modified: 2026-11-03 voxel-scholar: extracted from the single-file prototype. This is a 257-character subset. Fields n (stroke names), ok (whether the name is shown to children), and t (both / yc / old) are teaching annotations from that prototype, not upstream graphics.txt. Paths were not redrawn.
